completion_promises.criterion_text: At LifecycleBridge initialisation (before recover_in_flight), the bridge calls the sidecar's /version (or equivalent SDK-exposed metadata endpoint) and compares against the declared range using packaging.specifiers.SpecifierSet.
completion_promises.evidence: src/forge/lifecycle_bridge/bridge.py was modified: LifecycleBridge.__init__ accepts an optional sidecar_url: str | None = None kwarg and, when non-None, calls check_langgraph_runner_version(sidecar_url) BEFORE storing the registry handle (and therefore before any subsequent recover_in_flight call — which is an externally-invoked instance method). The check internally constructs a packaging.specifiers.SpecifierSet(supported_range) and compares the parsed packaging.version.Version against it. Tests test_in_range_sidecar_constructs_cleanly and test_no_sidecar_url_skips_check verify the call site is reached (or correctly skipped) via a monkey-patched check.

completion_promises.criterion_text: On out-of-range version, the bridge raises LangGraphVersionMismatchError with message naming both the expected range and the observed version. The error propagates to daemon startup and fails the daemon (the daemon never finishes booting).
completion_promises.evidence: version_check.py defines `class LangGraphVersionMismatchError(RuntimeError)` carrying expected_range/observed_version attributes. Its __init__ sets the message to `f'langgraph-runner version skew: expected {expected_range}, observed {observed_version}. Bridge cannot start safely.'` — naming BOTH the range and the version. Tests test_above_range_raises (0.9.0) and test_below_range_raises (0.8.4) assert both substrings appear in str(excinfo.value); test_out_of_range_sidecar_fails_construction asserts the error propagates out of LifecycleBridge.__init__ via `with pytest.raises(LangGraphVersionMismatchError): LifecycleBridge(...)` — so the constructor never returns and the daemon never finishes booting. All assertions PASS.

completion_promises.criterion_text: The diagnostic is also printed to stderr (in addition to raising) so the operator sees it without needing logs: 'langgraph-runner version skew: expected {range}, observed {version}. Bridge cannot start safely.'

Bridge cannot start safely.'` and calls `print(diagnostic, file=err_stream)` BEFORE raising LangGraphVersionMismatchError. err_stream defaults to sys.stderr but is overridable via the stderr= kwarg for tests.
